summary: Confirmed both full-sample paired AI-help versus No-AI estimates against PDF pp. 9, 14 and 17, with design and measurement checked on pp. 8-13 and 18. All recorded statistics and participant counts match the paper and belong to the correct outcomes and analyses. The printed final sample is 263; each participant contributes one story in each condition and is counted once in n_total. The requested coding fields are consistent with the codebook. Read the complete markdown through the references and Appendices A-D and inspected the relevant PDF figures; no eligible outcome or contrast is missing. The other reported analyses concern self-assessment or nonrandomized process correlations, and no first-round-only contrast is reported. Both originality SDs are literally printed as 08, confirmed visually, so leaving their numeric fields null avoids guessing. The confidence-interval targets and d standardizers are not explicitly identified and appropriately remain unassigned.
